## Purpose

The annotated UMAP of the Cherry-PIC sorted-niche scRNA data — Figure 6B — as it is drawn in
the published figure: Mid-villus enterocytes removed, the annotation corrected for 237 cells,
and PCA → Harmony → UMAP **recomputed on the remaining 10,068 cells**.

The recomputation is what matters for the layout. `Fig6_scRNA_final.Rmd` also removes Mid-villus
enterocytes, but it subsets the original embedding, so the UMAP keeps the coordinates learned
with those cells present. The published panel comes from a fresh embedding, which puts the
small immune clusters (T helper, Cd8aa IEL, Plasmablasts) beside the macrophage block instead of
in an isolated island below it. UMAP layouts can be mirrored or rotated freely; only the
neighbourhood structure is meaningful, and that is what agrees with the published panel.

This code was generated in the Biomni session that produced the published figure; the delivered
package is kept unmodified in `Biomni-code-external/reproduce_plots/`. This notebook reads the
same two frozen objects and reproduces its plots.

## Outputs

Written to `../outputs/`. A `fig6B` prefix marks the published panel.

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| `fig6B_umap_celltype_broad.pdf` | **6B** — UMAP of the recomputed embedding, 13 broad cell types |
| `supporting_composition_stacked_broad_corrected.pdf` | composition by region on the corrected labels — see the note on 6C below |
| `supporting_dotplot_epithelia_zscore.pdf`, `supporting_dotplot_epithelia_log1p.pdf` | annotation marker dot plots, epithelial cell types |
| `supporting_dotplot_immune_stroma_zscore.pdf`, `supporting_dotplot_immune_stroma_log1p.pdf` | annotation marker dot plots, immune and stromal cell types |

**The dot plots are the published Figure S7.** The marker panel in
`../data/annotation_marker_genes_reduced.csv` is the gene list printed on Figure S7, and the
z-score plots reproduce that panel. They are written as `supporting_` here because
`FigS7_DotPlots_final.Rmd` still owns `figS7A`/`figS7B`; which script should own them is an open
decision, since the two differ in the annotation they read (see below).

**Fig 6C is affected by the same annotation correction.** `Fig6_scRNA_final.Rmd` computes 6C, and
its propeller statistics, from the uncorrected labels. The corrected composition is written here
for comparison; 6C itself and its propeller table were not changed.

## Inputs

| File | Contents |
|---|---|
| `../data/obj_no_midvillus.rds` | 10,068 cells, corrected `broad_cell_type`, original Harmony embedding kept |
| `../data/obj_no_midvillus_recomputed.rds` | the same cells with PCA, Harmony and UMAP recomputed — **the embedding plotted in 6B** |
| `../data/broad_cell_type_corrections.csv` | the 237 cells whose `broad_cell_type` changed, by cell name |
| `../data/annotation_marker_genes_reduced.csv` | 76-gene annotation marker panel behind the dot plots |
| `../data/annotation_marker_genes.csv` | the full 140-gene panel and its literature sources (provenance) |

Frozen. This notebook reads them; the two objects are rebuilt in the provenance chunks below,
which are not run here. Both objects derive from `../data/DR26001_v2_annotated_seurat_singlets.rds`,
the object `Fig6_scRNA_final.Rmd` reads.

**The annotation correction.** 172 cells labelled Mid-villus enterocytes are relabelled
"Brunner gland-like epithelial cells" and removed with the rest of the Mid-villus group, and 65
cells labelled Blood vascular endothelial cells become Fibroblasts. Nothing else changes. The
correction was delivered as an unnamed vector in cell order; it is stored here by cell name, and
every changed cell falls in exactly those two label pairs, which is the check that the order
matched.

## Running this

Runs in an ordinary R session, a few minutes:

```
Rscript Fig6B_UMAP_Recomputed_final.R
```

## Note — the recomputed embedding is not reproducible from code

Harmony's k-means initialisation is stochastic and carries no seed, unlike `RunUMAP`
(`seed.use = 42`), so re-running the build chunks below gives a different UMAP layout from the
frozen object, with the same clusters and neighbours. The frozen
`obj_no_midvillus_recomputed.rds` is the object the published panel was drawn from.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
if (nzchar(Sys.getenv("CHERRYPIC_R_LIB"))) .libPaths(c(Sys.getenv("CHERRYPIC_R_LIB"), .libPaths()))  # optional custom library

library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

## Provenance — how the two objects were built

Code-of-record, not run here.

```{r provenance-build, eval=FALSE}
library(harmony)

obj  <- readRDS("../data/DR26001_v2_annotated_seurat_singlets.rds")
corr <- read.csv("../data/broad_cell_type_corrections.csv")

# Apply the 237 corrections, fold the relabelled cells into the Mid-villus group, drop it.
obj$broad_cell_type[match(corr$cell, colnames(obj))] <- corr$broad_cell_type_corrected
obj$broad_cell_type[obj$broad_cell_type == "Brunner gland-like epithelial cells"] <-
  "Mid-villus enterocytes"
obj_filt <- subset(obj, subset = broad_cell_type != "Mid-villus enterocytes")   # 10,068 cells
saveRDS(obj_filt, "../data/obj_no_midvillus.rds")

# Recompute on the SCT assay, batch-correcting over sample of origin.
DefaultAssay(obj_filt) <- "SCT"
obj_filt <- FindVariableFeatures(obj_filt, assay = "SCT", nfeatures = 3000) |>
  ScaleData(assay = "SCT") |>
  RunPCA(assay = "SCT", npcs = 50)
obj_filt <- RunHarmony(obj_filt, group.by.vars = "orig.ident", reduction.use = "pca")
obj_filt <- RunUMAP(obj_filt, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:30)
saveRDS(obj_filt, "../data/obj_no_midvillus_recomputed.rds")
```

# Setup

```{r config}
data_dir <- "../data"
out_dir  <- "../outputs"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
op <- function(f) file.path(out_dir, f)

# Colours and row order as drawn in the published Figure 6. The label "Plamsablasts" is
# spelled as it is in the object's metadata.
ct_colors <- c(
  "CLU+ reserve stem cells"          = "#B12121",
  "TA cells/early progenitors"       = "#1C5E8E",
  "Bottom-Villus enterocytes"        = "#9E9AC7",
  "Paneth cells"                     = "#006C2C",
  "Enteroendocrine cells"            = "#74C476",
  "Goblet cells"                     = "#11A44B",
  "Blood vascular endothelial cells" = "#495800",
  "Fibroblasts"                      = "#DEB89A",
  "Macrophages"                      = "#A04F57",
  "Plamsablasts"                     = "#F8BAD0",
  "T_helper cells"                   = "#088A91",
  "Cd8aa IEL"                        = "#004D5E",
  "cDC1"                             = "#7D1C28"
)
ct_order <- names(ct_colors)

epithelial_cts    <- ct_order[1:6]
immune_stroma_cts <- ct_order[7:13]
```

```{r load}
obj_re   <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "obj_no_midvillus_recomputed.rds"))
obj_filt <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "obj_no_midvillus.rds"))
stopifnot(identical(colnames(obj_re), colnames(obj_filt)))

obj_re$broad_cell_type   <- factor(obj_re$broad_cell_type,   levels = ct_order)
obj_filt$broad_cell_type <- factor(obj_filt$broad_cell_type, levels = ct_order)
stopifnot(!anyNA(obj_re$broad_cell_type))

cat("Cells:", ncol(obj_re), "| Reductions:", paste(Reductions(obj_re), collapse = ", "), "\n")
print(table(obj_re$broad_cell_type))
```

# PART 1 — Manuscript panel

## Panel 6B — UMAP, recomputed embedding

```{r panel_6b, fig.width=6, fig.height=3.75}
umap_df <- data.frame(
  UMAP_1 = Embeddings(obj_re, "umap")[, 1],
  UMAP_2 = Embeddings(obj_re, "umap")[, 2],
  broad_cell_type = obj_re$broad_cell_type
)

p_umap <- ggplot(umap_df, aes(UMAP_1, UMAP_2, color = broad_cell_type)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = ct_colors, name = NULL) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3))) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 8) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 6), legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
        legend.key = element_blank(), plot.margin = margin(6, 6, 6, 6)) +
  labs(x = "UMAP-1", y = "UMAP-2")

ggsave(op("fig6B_umap_celltype_broad.pdf"), p_umap, width = 6, height = 3.75)
p_umap
```

# PART 2 — Supporting figures

## Composition by region, corrected labels

Cells per region as a percentage of that region's cells, on the corrected labels.

```{r composition, fig.width=4.54, fig.height=3.75}
comp_df <- obj_re@meta.data |>
  mutate(region = recode(orig.ident, MouseDuo = "Duodenum", Mouseileum = "Ileum")) |>
  count(region, broad_cell_type, name = "n") |>
  group_by(region) |>
  mutate(pct = 100 * n / sum(n)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(region = factor(region, levels = c("Duodenum", "Ileum")))

p_comp <- ggplot(comp_df, aes(region, pct, fill = broad_cell_type)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = ct_colors, name = NULL, drop = FALSE) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 8) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 6), legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
        plot.margin = margin(6, 6, 6, 6)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "% Composition")

ggsave(op("supporting_composition_stacked_broad_corrected.pdf"), p_comp, width = 4.54, height = 3.75)
p_comp
```

## Annotation marker dot plots

Colour is the per-gene z-score of mean log-normalised expression across the cell types shown;
size is the fraction of cells expressing. A second version colours by the log-normalised mean
itself. The RNA assay carries no normalised layer in the frozen object, so it is normalised here.

```{r dotplots, fig.width=12, fig.height=3.75}
inferno_rev <- c("#FCFFA4", "#F7D13D", "#FB9A06", "#ED6925", "#CF4446",
                 "#A52C60", "#781C6D", "#4A0C6B", "#1B0C42", "#000004")

panel <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "annotation_marker_genes_reduced.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
panel <- panel[panel$broad_cell_type != "Mid-villus enterocytes", ]

DefaultAssay(obj_filt) <- "RNA"
obj_filt <- NormalizeData(obj_filt, assay = "RNA", verbose = FALSE)

compute_dotdata <- function(panel_sub, ct_order) {
  gene_order <- panel_sub$gene
  expr <- GetAssayData(obj_filt, assay = "RNA", layer = "data")[unique(gene_order), , drop = FALSE]
  cells_by_ct <- split(colnames(obj_filt), as.character(obj_filt$broad_cell_type))

  rows <- list()
  for (i in seq_along(gene_order)) {
    g <- gene_order[i]
    if (!(g %in% rownames(expr))) next
    for (j in seq_along(ct_order)) {
      cells <- cells_by_ct[[ct_order[j]]]
      if (length(cells) == 0) next
      vals <- expr[g, cells]
      rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- data.frame(slot = i, gene = g, ct_pos = j,
        cell_type = ct_order[j], pct_exp = mean(vals > 0), avg_exp = mean(vals))
    }
  }
  dd <- do.call(rbind, rows)
  # z-score per gene across cell types, before zero-expression dots are dropped
  dd$z_score <- ave(dd$avg_exp, dd$gene, FUN = function(x) {
    s <- sd(x); if (s == 0) 0 else (x - mean(x)) / s
  })
  dd[dd$avg_exp > 0, ]
}

make_dotplot <- function(dd, ct_order, title, fill_var, fill_limits, fill_name) {
  gene_breaks <- sort(unique(dd$slot))
  gene_labels <- vapply(gene_breaks, function(s) dd$gene[dd$slot == s][1], character(1))
  ggplot(dd, aes(x = slot, y = ct_pos)) +
    geom_point(aes(fill = .data[[fill_var]], size = pct_exp), shape = 21, color = "black", stroke = 0.25) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(name = fill_name, colors = inferno_rev, limits = fill_limits) +
    scale_size_continuous(name = "% Expressing", range = c(0.8, 5), limits = c(0, 1)) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = gene_breaks, labels = gene_labels, expand = c(0.02, 0.02)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq_along(ct_order), labels = gsub("_", " ", ct_order),
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0.08, 0.04), add = c(0.2, 0.1))) +
    ggtitle(title) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 8) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 6),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6), plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 6), legend.title = element_text(size = 7),
          plot.margin = margin(6, 6, 6, 6))
}

compartments <- list(epithelia = epithelial_cts, immune_stroma = immune_stroma_cts)
for (nm in names(compartments)) {
  cts <- compartments[[nm]]
  panel_sub <- panel[panel$broad_cell_type %in% cts, ]
  panel_sub <- panel_sub[order(factor(panel_sub$broad_cell_type, levels = cts), panel_sub$gene_order), ]
  dd <- compute_dotdata(panel_sub, cts)
  cat(nm, "| genes:", nrow(panel_sub), "| cell types:", length(cts), "| dots:", nrow(dd), "\n")

  z_max <- max(abs(dd$z_score))
  p_z <- make_dotplot(dd, cts, nm, "z_score", c(-z_max, z_max), "Z-score")
  ggsave(op(paste0("supporting_dotplot_", nm, "_zscore.pdf")), p_z, width = 12, height = 3.75)
  print(p_z)

  p_l <- make_dotplot(dd, cts, nm, "avg_exp", c(0, max(dd$avg_exp)), "Log1p expression")
  ggsave(op(paste0("supporting_dotplot_", nm, "_log1p.pdf")), p_l, width = 12, height = 3.75)
}
```
